SELECT b.name AS child, substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(e.local_at, ''), e.started_at), 1, 10) AS day, SUM(e.entry_type = 'feed') AS feeds, CASE WHEN SUM(e.entry_type = 'feed') > SUM(e.feed_kind IN ('bottle','nurse-left','nurse-right','solids')) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(e.feed_kind IN ('nurse-left','nurse-right')) END AS breast, CASE WHEN SUM(e.entry_type = 'feed') > SUM(e.feed_kind IN ('bottle','nurse-left','nurse-right','solids')) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(e.feed_kind = 'bottle') END AS bottles, CASE WHEN SUM(e.entry_type = 'feed') > SUM(e.feed_kind IN ('bottle','nurse-left','nurse-right','solids')) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(e.feed_kind = 'solids') END AS solids, SUM(CASE WHEN e.entry_type = 'feed' THEN e.amount_ml END) AS fed_ml, SUM(e.entry_type = 'diaper') AS diapers, CASE WHEN SUM(e.entry_type = 'diaper') > SUM(e.diaper_kind IN ('wet','dirty','both')) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(e.diaper_kind IN ('wet','both')) END AS wet, CASE WHEN SUM(e.entry_type = 'diaper') > SUM(e.diaper_kind IN ('wet','dirty','both')) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(e.diaper_kind IN ('dirty','both')) END AS dirty, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.entry_type = 'sleep' AND e.ended_at > e.started_at THEN julianday(e.ended_at) - julianday(e.started_at) END) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.1f', SUM(CASE WHEN e.entry_type = 'sleep' AND e.ended_at > e.started_at THEN julianday(e.ended_at) - julianday(e.started_at) END) * 24) END AS sleep_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN e.entry_type = 'pump' THEN e.amount_ml END) AS pumped_ml FROM app_baby_log__entries e JOIN app_baby_log__babies b ON b.id = e.baby_id WHERE b.archived = 0 AND substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(e.local_at, ''), e.started_at), 1, 10) BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' GROUP BY b.id, day ORDER BY b.created_at, b.id, day DESC

SELECT b.name AS child, COALESCE(NULLIF(e.local_at, ''), e.started_at) AS at_time, CASE e.entry_type WHEN 'feed' THEN 'Feed' WHEN 'diaper' THEN 'Diaper' WHEN 'sleep' THEN 'Sleep' WHEN 'pump' THEN 'Pumping' WHEN 'note' THEN 'Note' ELSE e.entry_type END AS kind, CASE e.entry_type WHEN 'feed' THEN CASE e.feed_kind WHEN 'bottle' THEN 'Bottle' WHEN 'nurse-left' THEN 'Breast, left' WHEN 'nurse-right' THEN 'Breast, right' WHEN 'solids' THEN 'Solids' ELSE e.feed_kind END WHEN 'diaper' THEN CASE e.diaper_kind WHEN 'wet' THEN 'Wet' WHEN 'dirty' THEN 'Dirty' WHEN 'both' THEN 'Wet and dirty' ELSE e.diaper_kind END ELSE '' END AS detail, e.amount_ml AS amount_ml, CASE WHEN e.ended_at > e.started_at THEN CAST(ROUND((julianday(e.ended_at) - julianday(e.started_at)) * 1440) AS INTEGER) END AS minutes, e.note AS note, CASE WHEN e.created_by_name = '' THEN e.created_by ELSE e.created_by_name END AS who FROM app_baby_log__entries e JOIN app_baby_log__babies b ON b.id = e.baby_id WHERE b.archived = 0 AND substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(e.local_at, ''), e.started_at), 1, 10) BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' ORDER BY b.created_at, b.id, e.started_at DESC, e.id

SELECT b.name AS child, g.measured_date AS measured_date, CASE WHEN g.weight_g IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.3f', g.weight_g / 1000.0) END AS weight_kg, CASE WHEN g.weight_g IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%d lb %.1f oz', CAST(ROUND(g.weight_g / 28.349523125, 1) / 16 AS INTEGER), ROUND(g.weight_g / 28.349523125, 1) - 16 * CAST(ROUND(g.weight_g / 28.349523125, 1) / 16 AS INTEGER)) END AS weight_lb, CASE WHEN g.length_mm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.1f', g.length_mm / 10.0) END AS length_cm, CASE WHEN g.length_mm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.1f', g.length_mm / 25.4) END AS length_in, CASE WHEN g.head_mm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.1f', g.head_mm / 10.0) END AS head_cm, CASE WHEN g.head_mm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE printf('%.1f', g.head_mm / 25.4) END AS head_in, g.note AS note, CASE WHEN g.created_by_name = '' THEN g.created_by ELSE g.created_by_name END AS who FROM app_baby_log__growth g JOIN app_baby_log__babies b ON b.id = g.baby_id WHERE b.archived = 0 AND g.measured_date >= '2026-01-01' AND g.measured_date <= '2026-01-31' ORDER BY b.created_at, b.id, g.measured_date DESC, g.created_at DESC
